_comment: Bundled vocabulary for the review-signoff validator (contract requirement 3).
Kept in sync with contract/review-signoff.schema.json by scripts/check_repo.py.
These are REVIEW SHAPES and CADENCES — the recurring patterns in which a human attests to
machine output. They are not framework content: no control text, no guidance, no evidence-item
list. What is due, and what a control needs, comes from the customer's own organization at scan
time over MCP, never from this file. See contract/README.md, requirement 9.
_cadence_days_comment: The window an expiry is allowed to fall in, counted in days from decided_at. A quarterly review
that claims a two-year sign-off is not a quarterly review, and that is the single most common
way an expiring attestation quietly stops meaning anything. The windows are deliberately wide:
the check is meant to catch a wrong cadence, not to police a fortnight's slippage.
